notice: All companies, evidence, standards, and incidents below are fictional design examples. No human approval is claimed.

diagnosis.business_problem: Discovery conversations lead to proposals before the customer problem is understood.

learner_brief.delivery: English, desktop, self-paced; no live customer data

evidence.expected: Confirm the desired business change before recommending
evidence.actual: Seller recommends an AI platform immediately after an inventory AI request
evidence.limitation: One fictional incident illustrates a gap; it cannot establish prevalence or causation.

gaps.task: Clarify the business problem during discovery

diagnosis.next_action: Validate the cause with observation and SME/learner input before approving a training intervention. The downstream drafts illustrate the conditional design only.

notes.incident: A retailer requests inventory AI; the seller offers features before exploring the problem.
notes.decision: Explore the outcome or recommend immediately
notes.common_mistake: Treating a requested solution as a validated need
notes.exception: If the customer cannot share details, agree on a follow-up with the appropriate stakeholders.

content.item: Elicit and confirm the intended business outcome
ClearLake cannot guarantee accurate forecasts merely by connecting data

content.reason: Consult during work rather than memorize
Outside the scope of this introductory discovery objective

objectives.text: By the end of the lesson, sales representatives will be able to clarify a prospective customer's business need before recommending a solution.
objectives.standard: Discovery questioning and confirmation of the stated need precede a recommendation; rubric requires ID/SME confirmation. Customer purchase is not a success criterion.
objectives.achievability: One scoped conversation with a worked example and guided practice
objectives.learner_facing_purpose: Find out what the customer needs before proposing a solution.
objectives.conditions_note: Specify allowed references in the assessment brief if they affect the evidence; no invented speed or percentage requirement.

enabling_objectives.text: Identify information still needed to clarify a customer's business problem.
Use discovery questions to elicit the customer's desired business outcome.
Summarize the customer's stated need to check understanding before recommending a solution.

assessment_brief.aspect: LO1a: identify the need to explore the business problem before recommending
assessment_brief.limitation: This decision item does not establish LO1b/LO1c or the full terminal behavior; open-conversation evidence is still required.

evaluation.L2: Decision rationale; later role-play evidence for the full behavior
evaluation.L3: Proposed workplace observation; timing and owner pending
evaluation.L4: Business measure and baseline pending; no outcome claim

blocks.text: A customer says: We want inventory AI. Can your platform do it? What do you need to learn before recommending?
blocks.visual: Fictional chat workspace; customer request beside an empty discovery notes panel
blocks.accessibility: The complete request is available as text; visual decoration is not required to understand it.

blocks.text: Ask what business outcome needs to change, then summarize the response to check understanding.
blocks.reasoning: A solution request does not yet tell us what problem to solve.

blocks.prompt: A different customer asks to replace its reporting system. What do you do first?

choices.text: Clarify the problem with current reporting.
choices.consequence: The customer describes the actual reporting difficulty.
choices.feedback: Discovery establishes the problem before selecting a solution.

choices.text: Recommend a full migration to our platform.
choices.consequence: The customer asks why a migration is necessary.
choices.feedback: The recommendation is premature without understanding the problem.

choices.text: Offer a discount for signing this quarter.
choices.consequence: The customer repeats its concern about reporting.
choices.feedback: A discount does not clarify the operational need.
